public_events.text: I’ll use the AutoCAD modeling skill, inspect the supplied dimensions, and build the part in isolated Core Console jobs with recoverable DWG checkpoints.

The views indicate an 80 × 30 × 65 mm part with a 15 mm base, a 12 mm top flange, and a 10 mm web. I’ve also resolved the end slot, the underside recess, four Ø3.4 holes, and eight C3 corners. I’ll represent the M5 blind hole with a nominal Ø5 bore, 16 mm deep.

arguments.lisp:
(defun c:buildbody (/ base top web solids)
  (setvar "CMDECHO" 0)
  (setvar "OSMODE" 0)
  (setvar "INSUNITS" 4)
  (setvar "LUNITS" 2)
  (setvar "LUPREC" 6)
  (setvar "DELOBJ" 1)
  (setvar "SOLIDHIST" 1)
  (command "_.UCS" "_World")
  (defun prism (pts z height / ent)
    (entmake (append (list '(0 . "LWPOLYLINE") '(100 . "AcDbEntity") '(100 . "AcDbPolyline") (cons 90 (length pts)) '(70 . 1) (cons 38 z)) (mapcar '(lambda (p) (cons 10 p)) pts)))
    (setq ent (entlast))
    (command "_.EXTRUDE" ent "" height)
    (if (/= (cdr (assoc 0 (entget (entlast)))) "3DSOLID") (progn (princ "\nPRISM_FAILED") (exit)))
    (entlast)
  )
  (setq base (prism '((0 -12) (3 -15) (77 -15) (80 -12) (80 12) (77 15) (3 15) (0 12)) 0 15))
  (setq top (prism '((30 -12) (33 -15) (77 -15) (80 -12) (80 12) (77 15) (33 15) (30 12)) 53 12))
  (setq web (prism '((30 -5) (80 -5) (80 5) (30 5)) 15 38))
  (command "_.UNION" base top web "")
  (setq solids (ssget "_X" '((0 . "3DSOLID") (410 . "Model"))))
  (princ (strcat "\nBODY_SOLID_COUNT=" (itoa (sslength solids))))
  (command "_.MASSPROP" solids "" "_No")
  (command "_.VPOINT" '(-1 -1 0.7))
  (command "_.ZOOM" "_Extents")
  (princ)
)

(defun c:cutfeatures (/ body cut solids report)
  (setvar "CMDECHO" 0)
  (setvar "OSMODE" 0)
  (setvar "FILEDIA" 0)
  (setvar "DELOBJ" 1)
  (setvar "FACETRES" 10)
  (command "_.UCS" "_World")
  (defun prism (pts z height / ent)
    (entmake (append (list '(0 . "LWPOLYLINE") '(100 . "AcDbEntity") '(100 . "AcDbPolyline") (cons 90 (length pts)) '(70 . 1) (cons 38 z)) (mapcar '(lambda (p) (cons 10 p)) pts)))
    (setq ent (entlast))
    (command "_.EXTRUDE" ent "" height)
    (entlast)
  )
  (defun bodyentity () (ssname (ssget "_X" '((0 . "3DSOLID") (410 . "Model"))) 0))
  (setq body (bodyentity))
  (setq cut (prism '((-1 -13.5) (81 -13.5) (81 13.5) (-1 13.5)) -1 4))
  (command "_.SUBTRACT" body "" cut "")
  (setq body (bodyentity))
  (setq cut (prism '((-1 -5.5) (5 -5.5) (5 -9.5) (13 -9.5) (13 9.5) (5 9.5) (5 5.5) (-1 5.5)) -1 17))
  (command "_.SUBTRACT" body "" cut "")
  (foreach center '((30 -10 2) (30 10 2) (45 -10 2) (45 10 2))
    (setq body (bodyentity))
    (command "_.CYLINDER" center 1.7 14)
    (setq cut (entlast))
    (command "_.SUBTRACT" body "" cut "")
  )
  (setq body (bodyentity))
  (command "_.CYLINDER" '(50 0 49) 2.5 17)
  (setq cut (entlast))
  (command "_.SUBTRACT" body "" cut "")
  (setq solids (ssget "_X" '((0 . "3DSOLID") (410 . "Model"))))
  (setq report (open "[private value removed]" "w"))
  (write-line (strcat "3DSOLID count: " (itoa (sslength solids))) report)
  (write-line (strcat "All model entities: " (itoa (sslength (ssget "_X" '((410 . "Model")))))) report)
  (write-line (strcat "INSUNITS: " (itoa (getvar "INSUNITS"))) report)
  (write-line "M5 represented by nominal diameter 5 mm, flat-bottom blind bore, depth 16 mm." report)
  (close report)
  (command "_.MASSPROP" solids "" "_Yes" "[private value removed]")
  (command "_.STLOUT" solids "" "_Yes" "[private value removed]")
  (command "_.VPOINT" '(-1 -1 0.7))
  (command "_.ZOOM" "_Extents")
  (princ)
)

import pathlib, json, numpy as np, trimesh
from PIL import Image,ImageDraw
root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
mesh=trimesh.load(root/'stage02-preview.stl',force='mesh',process=True)
mesh.apply_translation(np.array([40,0,32.5])-mesh.bounds.mean(axis=0))
verts=mesh.vertices; faces=mesh.faces; normals=mesh.face_normals
edges=mesh.face_adjacency_edges[mesh.face_adjacency_angles>0.35]
W,H=650,620
def render(elev,azim):
 e,a=np.radians([elev,azim]);eye=np.array([np.cos(e)*np.cos(a),np.cos(e)*np.sin(a),np.sin(e)])
 right=np.array([-np.sin(a),np.cos(a),0]);up=np.cross(eye,right)
 proj=[email removed]([right,up,eye]).T
 lo=proj[:,:2].min(0); hi=proj[:,:2].max(0); scale=min((W-65)/(hi[0]-lo[0]),(H-80)/(hi[1]-lo[1]))
 p=np.column_stack([(proj[:,0]-(lo[0]+hi[0])/2)*scale+W/2,H/2-(proj[:,1]-(lo[1]+hi[1])/2)*scale,proj[:,2]])
 img=np.full((H,W,3),255,dtype=np.uint8);zb=np.full((H,W),-np.inf)
 light=eye*0.5+np.array([-0.3,-0.5,0.8]);light/=np.linalg.norm(light)
 for face,normal in zip(faces,normals):
  if normal@eye<-1e-8: continue
  q=p[face];xmin=max(0,int(np.floor(q[:,0].min())));xmax=min(W-1,int(np.ceil(q[:,0].max())))
  ymin=max(0,int(np.floor(q[:,1].min())));ymax=min(H-1,int(np.ceil(q[:,1].max())))
  xx,yy=np.meshgrid(np.arange(xmin,xmax+1)+0.5,np.arange(ymin,ymax+1)+0.5)
  x0,y0,z0=q[0];x1,y1,z1=q[1];x2,y2,z2=q[2]
  den=(y1-y2)*(x0-x2)+(x2-x1)*(y0-y2)
  if abs(den)<1e-9: continue
  b0=((y1-y2)*(xx-x2)+(x2-x1)*(yy-y2))/den
  b1=((y2-y0)*(xx-x2)+(x0-x2)*(yy-y2))/den;b2=1-b0-b1
  z=b0*z0+b1*z1+b2*z2
  mask=(b0>=-1e-8)&(b1>=-1e-8)&(b2>=-1e-8)&(z>zb[ymin:ymax+1,xmin:xmax+1])
  shade=0.63+0.31*max(-0.5,normal@light)
  img[ymin:ymax+1,xmin:xmax+1][mask]=np.clip(np.array([190,200,218])*shade,0,255).astype(np.uint8)
  zb[ymin:ymax+1,xmin:xmax+1][mask]=z[mask]
 for edge in edges:
  q0,q1=p[edge];n=max(2,int(np.linalg.norm(q1[:2]-q0[:2])*2))
  line=q0[None,:]+np.linspace(0,1,n)[:,None]*(q1-q0)[None,:]
  x=np.rint(line[:,0]).astype(int);y=np.rint(line[:,1]).astype(int)
  for dx,dy in [(0,0)]:
   xc=np.clip(x+dx,0,W-1);yc=np.clip(y+dy,0,H-1)
   visible=line[:,2]>=zb[yc,xc]-0.12
   img[yc[visible],xc[visible]]=[38,44,53]
 return Image.fromarray(img)
canvas=Image.new('RGB',(W*3,H*2),'white');draw=ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
for i,(title,e,a) in enumerate([('Isometric',25,-130),('Underside',-30,-130),('Top',90,-90),('Side',0,-90),('End',0,0),('Bottom',-90,-90)]):
 im=render(e,a);canvas.paste(im,((i%3)*W,(i//3)*H))
 draw.text(((i%3)*W+24,(i//3)*H+15),title,fill='black',font_size=23)
canvas.save(root/'stage02-inspection.png')
print('Saved depth-tested inspection render.')
